messages:
maria: Procurement from Stratos sent an RFP checklist — they need our SOC 2 report, ISO overview, signed pen-test attestation, a redacted network diagram, and confirmation of key management for the POC. They want these artifacts within 6 business days. who can assemble?

noah: Quick clarification: is the POC going to run in our shared hosted tier, an isolated tenancy, or Dedicated? that changes what we can promise in the package and influences pricing.

maria: They stated isolation is required for demo data. Theyd prefer Dedicated long-term but might accept hosted-isolated tenancy for the short POC if we provide a clear separation statement.

sara: I can pull SOC2 (latest) and the ISO summary and produce a trimmed package. we should redact internal ticket IDs and any customer IP on the network diagram. how do they want delivery — secure portal link or encrypted S3 + temp-creds?

security-bot: :page_with_curl: Required artifacts checklist (auto): [SOC2 report 2025], [ISO 27001 summary], [Pen-test attestation template], [Redacted infra diagram], [KMS key flow doc]. Before sharing, run: `tools/pii_scan --path ./packaged_artifacts` and attach the scan output.

devops: pen-test attestation template below — we usually sign on company letterhead (pdf).

```
To whom it may concern,

Redwood Inference engaged an independent security assessor on {date}. The assessment covered externally-facing inference endpoints used in our hosted and dedicated environments. No findings classified as Critical were identified for the scoped endpoints at the time of testing. This attestation is provided for procurement/POC purposes only and does not replace the full penetration test report.

Sincerely,
Redwood Inference Security
```

maria: thanks. two asks: (1) noah — can you confirm if Stratos will accept hosted-isolated tenancy for the POC so we can avoid Dedicated pricing up front? (2) sara — please sanitize diagrams and run the pii scan before release.

noah: Im asking procurement now. also requesting a ballpark 3-month Dedicated commit price for the RFP (they asked to include committed pricing). will post reply shortly.

sara: will redact and run scan. delivery preference: secure portal link with one-time expiring access OK? should include a manifest listing files and a signed attestation pdf. ETA: EOD Mon if noah confirms environment today.

devops: I can sign the attestation PDF once sara prepares it and well attach signature metadata. If legal needs notarization that will add time.

maria: perfect. action items:
- sara: assemble SOC2/ISO + redacted diagram, run PII scan, produce expiring portal link + manifest (EOD Mon)
- devops: sign pen-test attestation PDF once ready
- noah: confirm POC tenancy acceptance and include 3-month Dedicated price in RFP reply

sara: ack. Ill also include a short README explaining what each artifact demonstrates (control mappings to procurement checklist) so they can tick boxes.

security-bot: :white_check_mark: Logged: Assurance request for Stratos POC. Due in 6 business days. Ticket ASSURE-4999.
